programs.sub_title: Buried Lab of the Black Hills
programs.desc: Buried nearly a mile beneath the Black Hills of South Dakota is a cutting-edge laboratory at the forefront of astonishing scientific research; experts reveal advancements engineers achieved more than a century ago that keep it operating today.

programs.title: Underground Marvels
programs.desc: Deep beneath the streets of Cincinnati lies a network of deserted tunnels and caverns that contain a remarkable history of the city's origins, and now, experts investigate to reveal who built this underground labyrinth and why it was abandoned.

programs.title: Dino Hunters
programs.desc: Clayton Phipps and his son Luke put it all on the line for a risky raptor fossil buried under 30 feet of earth. And the Harrises decide to go for broke to prep their multi-million dollar T. rex skull.

programs.title: Dino Hunters
programs.desc: Clayton and Luke begin to excavate the deep overburden that covers the Tyrannosaurus rex site; while Mike Harris travels to Utah to prep the Cowboy rex skull, Aaron, Jake and Tori think they're on a bucket-list discovery at the Duckbill site.

programs.title: Dino Hunters
programs.desc: When a wildfire surrounds his hometown, Clayton Phipps drops everything to help fight the flames; the Harris-Bolan crew excavates a new Triceratops' site; and the Abercrombie family discovers a mammoth fossil map on its ranch in New Mexico.

programs.title: Dino Hunters
